description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90/3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] depending on entry damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and [Crystal Force Mode: Thancred] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Thancred
description.text: Holy/Earth/Wind/Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy/Earth/Wind/Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if the user hasn't Crystal Force Mode
